---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect evidence handling, installation, rendering or language behavior
---

Describe the input and expected/actual behavior. Include the OSS Gate version, host client/version, operating system and selected language.

For an evidence issue, include only public package identifiers, the snapshot date, coverage flags and a minimal redacted reproduction. Do not paste private manifests, credentials or customer data. Report security vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.

List the commands or steps needed to reproduce and any relevant error message.
